ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply; see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for the EOL Oak Brook SELP (Ed Admin) and CCEL (Higher Ed) Doctoral cohorts. Class sessions will be held on the following Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays: July 8, 9, 10; July 15, 16, 17 and July 22, 23, 24; Classes meet on Thursdays from 3:00 to 8:00 pm, Fridays from 8:00 am to 3:00pm, and on Saturdays from 8:00 am to 12:00 pm. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
